terms_privacy_description: How {siteName} works, and what it keeps about you.
terms_privacy_use_unofficial: {siteName} is a fan-made tool. It isn't run by or affiliated with Modhaus or Cosmo.
terms_privacy_use_conduct: Don't scam, harass, spam or pretend to be someone else. Anyone can report a user who does.
terms_privacy_use_moderation: Moderators review reports. They can warn an account, mute it in chat, block it from trading or ban it.
terms_privacy_use_trades: Trades are between you and the other collector. {siteName} can't guarantee a trade or get objekts back.
terms_privacy_data_sign_in: Signing in with Discord or X gives us your name, username and picture, plus your email address from Discord. We never post for you.
terms_privacy_data_stored: We keep what you make here: lists, pins, linked Cosmo profiles, trades, messages and settings. Each sign-in records your IP address and browser, to keep your sessions secure.
terms_privacy_data_public: Collections and transfers shown here come from the public blockchain, not from your account.
terms_privacy_data_chat: Messages are checked for common scam signs, like asking someone to send first or pay through PayPal. A match shows a caution in the chat and is noted for moderators.
terms_privacy_data_reports: Moderators can't read your messages. They see a conversation only when someone reports it and chooses to share it, and that copy includes messages you unsent.
terms_privacy_data_email: We email you only to verify your address, reset your password or confirm deleting your account.
terms_privacy_data_no_sell: We don't sell or share your data.
terms_privacy_data_delete: You can delete your account in {#link}account settings{/link}. That removes the account and the data tied to it.
terms_privacy_points_open_source: {siteName} is open source. {#link}See the code on GitHub{/link}.
